body: Dr. Meera, JIDA Oct issue landed. One finding directly relevant to your 124 high-risk adult patients — 2,100-patient trial showed 3-month fluoride recall cuts caries recurrence 38% better than 6-month (no effect in low-risk patients). Worth a look (2-min abstract). Want me to pull it + draft a patient-ed WhatsApp you can share with your high-risk cohort? — JIDA Oct 2026, p.14
rationale: Research digest trigger: anchors on 3 verifiable specifics (2,100 patients, 38% better, JIDA Oct 2026 p.14) + merchant-cohort personalization (124 high-risk adults from customer_aggregate). Compulsion lever: curiosity + effort externalization ('I'll pull it + draft it').

body: Dr. Meera, heads up — DCI circular (2026-11-04) drops the max IOPA dose limit from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv, effective 15 Dec 2026. E-speed film and digital RVG pass at the new limit; D-speed does not. 6 weeks left to audit your setup. Want me to draft the SOP documentation note for your records?
rationale: Regulation change trigger: leads with specific deadline (Dec 15), cites source (DCI circular date), names exactly which equipment is/isn't compliant. Compulsion lever: urgency (6 weeks) + effort externalization (SOP draft).

body: Hi Priya, Dr. Meera's clinic yahan se 🦷 5 mahine ho gaye aapki last cleaning ke — aapka 6-month recall due hai. 2 slots ready hain: Wed 5 Nov, 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov, 5pm. ₹299 cleaning + complimentary fluoride check. Reply 1 for Wed, 2 for Thu, ya koi aur time batayein.
rationale: Customer recall trigger (merchant_on_behalf): personalizes by name, cites exact months lapsed (5), offers specific slot times from payload, uses active catalog price (₹299), adds complimentary value, language matches hi-en mix pref. Slot-choice CTA is preferred for booking flows.

body: Bharat, calls dropped 50% this week vs your 12/month baseline — down to just 4. Profile shows no active offer + GBP still unverified. A 'Dental Cleaning @ ₹299' offer activated today can reverse this fast — other Andheri-area dentists using service+price offers average 2× the calls of those without. Kya activate karein? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: Perf dip trigger: names exact metric (calls, -50%), cites baseline (12/month), anchors social proof (Andheri-area dentist benchmark), links cause (no offer + unverified GBP) to fix. Binary CTA. Language uses hi-en mix as per Bharat's language pref.

body: Bharat, Pro subscription expires in 12 days. Last 30 days: 980 views, 4 calls — even with the current dip. Without renewal, profile goes dark and those 980 monthly impressions go to competitors. ₹4,999 mein renew karein aur profile live rakhein? Reply YES to continue / STOP to discuss.
rationale: Renewal trigger: frames around value created (980 views) rather than 'subscription expires', uses loss aversion (profile goes dark), specific days remaining (12), plan price (₹4,999). Hi-en mix language match.

body: Dr. Meera, IDA Delhi webinar tonight (2 May, 7pm) — 'Digital impressions: Primescan 2, Trios 5, CAD/CAM ROI for solo practices.' 2 CDE credits. Free for IDA members (₹500 otherwise). Worth joining if CAD/CAM workflow is on your radar?
rationale: CDE opportunity trigger: time-critical (tonight), lists specific content (equipment names), quantifies benefit (2 credits), states cost (free for members), respects peer_clinical tone. Low-pressure open-ended question.

body: Dr. Meera, FYI — Smile Studio opened 1.3km from you on Apr 8 with 'Dental Cleaning @ ₹199' (vs your ₹299). Your rating advantage is real, but GBP posts are 22 days stale — that's the gap they can exploit in local search. Want me to draft 2 posts + update your profile description this week?
rationale: Competitor opened trigger: names competitor + distance + their exact offer, frames merchant's own signal (stale_posts:22d) as the vulnerability, offers specific action (2 posts + description). Peer-tone, no alarm.

body: Lakshmi, Diwali is 188 days out (Oct 31) — salons in Kapra start filling festive bookings 60-90 days ahead. Studio11's call volume (62 calls this month, above peer median) shows strong demand right now. Want me to draft a pre-Diwali combo offer (Hair Spa @ ₹499 + blowdry) as a GBP post + WhatsApp broadcast to your 1,150 customers? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: Festival trigger: specific countdown (188 days), cites actual call volume (62/month, above peer), mentions customer base size (1,150), uses catalog price (₹499 Hair Spa). Effort externalization ('I'll draft both'). Early-bird urgency framing.

body: Hi Kavya! Studio11 here 💍 Your bridal trial was on 22 March — your wedding is in 196 days (8 Nov). The 30-day skin prep program works best when started 5-6 months before, which makes this the ideal window. Want to book your skin prep consultation this Saturday? Reply YES to confirm your slot.
rationale: Wedding package followup (merchant_on_behalf): anchors on trial date and wedding date from relationship data, calculates window (196 days), explains WHY NOW (30-day program, 5-6 month timing), single slot-booking CTA. English matches Kavya's language_pref.

body: Lakshmi, quick one — what's the most-asked service at Studio11 this week: balayage, keratin smoothening, or bridal packages?
rationale: Curious ask trigger: no preamble, single specific question with 3 named options from salon vocabulary, trivially easy to reply in one word. Uses merchant first name. Compulsion lever: asking the merchant (lever #7 — rarely fires in production Vera).

body: Anjali, 24 customers have lapsed since Glamour Lounge's subscription expired 38 days ago — at your typical footfall, that's roughly ₹12,000-18,000 in missed revenue. Profile is paused so Aundh searches are going to competitors. Calls are down 30% vs your active period. Want to reactivate today? Reply YES to start / STOP to schedule a call.
rationale: Winback trigger: anchors on specific lapsed count (24), days since expiry (38), derived revenue estimate, and call dip (-30%). Three loss aversion signals stacked for maximum compulsion. Binary CTA at end.

body: Anjali, aur kaisi chal rahi hain Glamour Lounge ki bookings is mahine? Koi naya service add kiya kya team ne?
rationale: Dormant trigger: no re-introduction, single short curiosity question in Hindi-English mix (Anjali's language pref includes hi + mr), genuinely asks about their business rather than pushing a sale. Re-engagement via asking (lever #7).

body: Suresh, DC vs MI tonight 7:30pm at Arun Jaitley Stadium — match nights drive 35-40% more pizza orders in Sant Nagar. Your current BOGO offer is Tue-Thu only (not active today, Sunday). Want me to activate a quick 'Match Night Special: 2 Pizzas @ ₹399' for tonight only? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: IPL match trigger: time-specific (tonight 7:30pm), names the match (DC vs MI) and venue, cites delivery uplift estimate (35-40%), identifies gap (current offer is Tue-Thu), proposes specific offer with price. High urgency, expires tonight.

body: Suresh, 4 reviews this month flag late delivery — one says 'took 50 mins for a 15 min ride.' With trial ending in 7 days, this pattern hurts conversion right when visibility matters most. Want me to draft a reply template for these reviews + a 'Delivery in 30 min or next order on us' GBP post to flip the narrative? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: Review theme trigger: quotes verbatim customer language ('took 50 mins for a 15 min ride'), anchors on count (4 reviews), adds urgency context (trial ending 7 days). Offers two concrete actions in one CTA. Loss aversion framing.

body: Suresh, Mylari is at 145 reviews — just 5 away from the 150 milestone. Your 42% repeat customer rate means regulars are the fastest source. Want me to draft a short WhatsApp to your frequent thali customers asking for a review, with the '₹149 Weekday Thali' offer as the hook?
rationale: Milestone imminent trigger: specific gap (5 reviews), leverages repeat_customer_pct (42%), proposes concrete path (WhatsApp to regulars) with existing offer as hook. Curiosity + social proof framing.

body: Suresh, here's the draft: 'Mylari Corporate Thali — min 10 orders, ₹129/head (vs ₹149 walk-in), guaranteed delivery within 3km in 45 min.' Your 45% delivery share shows logistics is ready. I can create the GBP listing + draft an outreach message for the 3 tech parks in Indiranagar. Shall I go ahead?
rationale: Active planning intent trigger (ACTION mode): merchant already said yes, so message gives the concrete plan immediately — pricing, MOQ, SLA, and delivery capability anchored in real data (45% delivery share). No re-qualifying. Effort externalization ('I'll create the GBP listing').

body: Karthik, views dipped 30% this week — normal for the post-resolution Apr-May window. PowerHouse's click-through is above peer median, so the listing is strong when people find it. Best lever for this window: push '3 FREE trial classes' to people searching 'gym in HSR Layout' right now. Want me to draft the GBP post + schedule for tomorrow?
rationale: Seasonal perf dip trigger: explicitly acknowledges the dip is expected (no false alarm), pivots to actionable opportunity, uses signal (above_peer_ctr) as strength anchor, proposes specific post content. Effort externalization CTA.

body: Hi Rashmi, PowerHouse here! It's been 57 days — hope the weight-loss journey's going okay outside the gym. We've just added a 6am summer strength circuit that a lot of our weight-loss members are using this season. 2 free sessions to ease back in — interested? Reply YES and I'll book you in.
rationale: Customer lapsed_hard trigger (merchant_on_behalf): personalizes by name, acknowledges exact days lapsed (57), references previous focus (weight_loss), offers a relevant new program, low-friction re-entry (2 free sessions). Warm win-back tone, English matches Rashmi's language pref.

body: Padma, here's the structure: 4-week Kids Yoga Summer Camp, age 7-12, Mon-Wed-Fri 9-9:45am, batch size 8 (boutique like your adult classes), ₹2,499 per child. I've drafted the GBP post + an Instagram carousel. Ready to publish — shall I go ahead?
rationale: Active planning intent trigger (ACTION mode): merchant asked, Vera responds with a concrete plan (4-week, age, schedule, batch size, price). Batch size tied to merchant's boutique_segment signal. Effort externalization (GBP + Instagram already drafted). No re-qualifying.

body: Hi! Zen Yoga Studio here 🧘 Your trial class was on 22 April — hope you enjoyed it! We have a spot open this Saturday (3 May, 8am) for the next session. Want to confirm your place? Reply YES and we'll save it.
rationale: Trial followup (merchant_on_behalf): references exact trial date (April 22) from relationship data, offers specific next slot (Saturday May 3, 8am from payload), single low-friction YES CTA. Short and warm — capitalises on trial enthusiasm within 48h window.

body: Padma, calls are up 15% this week vs your 18/month baseline — tracking to the kids yoga post. Zen's 55% trial-to-paid rate means this spike is high-value traffic. Want me to draft a follow-up WhatsApp specifically for the parents who enquired this week but haven't enrolled, while momentum is live?
rationale: Perf spike trigger: links spike (15% up, vs baseline 18) to identified driver (kids_yoga_post), quantifies opportunity using trial_to_paid (55% — best in boutique), proposes a specific targeted follow-up. Curiosity + reciprocity levers.

body: Ramesh, urgent — voluntary recall on atorvastatin batches AT2024-1102 and AT2024-1108 from MfrZ. Pull both batches now + hold dispensing. Sending your filtered customer list for this molecule immediately. Need the patient notification SMS draft as well? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: Supply alert trigger (urgency 5): leads with urgent action immediately (no preamble), names specific batch IDs and manufacturer, follows merchant's prior intent (they already asked for the list), offers patient notification draft. Effort externalization under urgency.

body: Namaskar, Apollo Health Plus (Malviya Nagar) ki taraf se. Aapki teeno regular medicines — metformin, atorvastatin, aur telmisartan — ka stock 28 April tak khatam hone wala hai. Aapka delivery address humare paas saved hai — kya main aaj hi order place kar dun ghar tak delivery ke liye? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: Chronic refill due (merchant_on_behalf): names all 3 molecules from payload, cites exact run-out date (April 28 — urgency), mentions saved delivery address to reduce friction, Hindi language to match elderly patient preference. Single YES/STOP CTA for easy reply.

body: Ramesh, summer demand data for Malviya Nagar: ORS +40%, sunscreen +38%, antifungal +45% vs last month. Cold/cough demand is down 60% — worth clearing that shelf space. Your Free Home Delivery offer is well-positioned for ORS + electrolyte repeat buys. Want me to draft a WhatsApp broadcast to your regular customers highlighting summer health essentials?
rationale: Category seasonal trigger: cites 4 specific trend percentages from payload, includes a negative signal (clear shelf), links to existing active offer (Free Delivery). Practical fellow-pharmacist tone with actionable recommendations. Reciprocity + specificity levers.

body: Hi Sunrise Pharmacy — Google Business Profile is unverified, which typically costs ~30% in views vs verified competitors in the same locality. Phone verification is the fastest path (5 minutes vs 2 weeks for postcard). Want me to walk you through the steps right now? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: GBP unverified trigger: quantifies the opportunity (30% uplift from payload), compares verification paths (phone vs postcard), offers immediate assistance. Loss aversion framing. Binary CTA. Trustworthy_precise tone matches pharmacy category.

body: Lakshmi, Studio11 ke iss hafte kaun si services mein zyada enquiries aa rahi hain — bridal packages ya hair treatments?
rationale: Curiosity ask for a high-engagement salon: single short question in Hindi-English mix, asks about the most operationally relevant insight (service demand mix). No preamble. Compulsion lever: asking the merchant (lever #7). Studio11's active status makes this a relationship deepener rather than re-engagement.

body: Suresh, Mylari is 5 reviews from 150 — in Indiranagar, cafes crossing 150 see a bump in map visibility and 'near me' ranking. Your 4,200 repeat customers are the fastest path. Want me to draft a personalised review-ask for your 38 most frequent diners (weekly thali regulars)?
rationale: Milestone alternate angle: adds locality context (Indiranagar visibility), quantifies the audience more precisely (38 most frequent regulars from customer data), uses social proof framing. Different angle from T15 which targeted all repeat customers.

body: Padma, calls up 15% from the kids yoga post + your 55% trial-to-paid is the strongest in the boutique segment. 3 parents enquired this week — if 2 enrol, that's ₹4,998 in new revenue in one week. Want me to draft a direct follow-up to the 3 who asked but haven't confirmed yet?
rationale: Perf spike + kids yoga combined: quantifies the revenue opportunity (2×₹2,499) from the spike, mentions the specific 3 unconfirmed leads, leverages trial-to-paid conversion rate as social proof. More concrete than T21 which is the baseline version.

body: Ramesh, antifungal demand in Jaipur is up 45% this month — typically spikes mid-May through July with heat + humidity. Check clotrimazole, miconazole, and fluconazole stock now before the peak. Want me to draft a 'Summer Skin Care' WhatsApp to your 24 regular customers so they buy from you before they run out?
rationale: Seasonal demand alternate focus: zooms in on antifungal +45% (highest single-molecule opportunity), names specific molecules for shelf audit, provides seasonal timing context (May-July peak). Practical pharmacist-to-pharmacist tone. Different from T24 which covers all summer trends.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI tonight 7:30pm — match night + you already have 4 'late delivery' reviews this month. High-volume night is both an opportunity and a risk. Want me to activate the 'Match Night Special @ ₹399' offer + draft a pre-emptive 'Order by 7pm for on-time delivery' story for tonight? Reply YES / STOP.
rationale: IPL match combined with review context: layers the match opportunity with the existing delivery_late review risk, framing tonight as both upside and downside. Creates urgency by connecting two live signals. Specific pricing and time anchor. Different risk-aware angle from T13.
